mapper.select: with tmpa as ( SELECT t1.REP_FINPROD_ID, t1.REP_INV_TYPE_RAT INVEST_RANGE,--投资范围 t1.REP_INV_ASSET_TYPE INVEST_TYPE--投资种类 FROM REP_PROD_DECLARE t1 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.UPDATE_TIME > #{updatetime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ), tmpb as ( SELECT t3.finprod_id, SUM(t3.SALE_MAX) RAISE_MAX--募集上限(多地区之和) FROM PRD_SALE_PARAM t3 WHERE 1=1 AND t3.UPDATE_TIME > #{updatetime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY t3.finprod_id ), ltmp as ( select tmpa.REP_FINPROD_ID PROD_ID, tmpa.INVEST_RANGE, tmpa.INVEST_TYPE, tmpb.RAISE_MAX from tmpa left join tmpb on tmpb.finprod_id = tmpa.rep_finprod_id ), rtmp as ( select tmpb.finprod_id PROD_ID, tmpa.INVEST_RANGE, tmpa.INVEST_TYPE, tmpb.RAISE_MAX from tmpb left join tmpa on tmpb.finprod_id = tmpa.rep_finprod_id ), lrtmp as ( select distinct PROD_ID, INVEST_RANGE, INVEST_TYPE, RAISE_MAX from ( select * from ltmp union all select * from rtmp ) temp ) /*每天抽取全量数据*/ SELECT A.ID, F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PROD_ID, A.INVEST_RANGE, A.INVEST_TYPE, now() ADJUST_DATE, A.RAISE_MAX FROM ( select F_GUID() ID, PROD_ID, INVEST_RANGE, INVEST_TYPE, RAISE_MAX from lrtmp ) A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON F.FINPROD_ID = A.PROD_ID WHERE F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL AND (INVEST_RANGE IS NOT NULL or RAISE_MAX is not null)
